picks.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
picks.angle: Gemini can now perform tasks directly on macOS, making it a powerful productivity assistant for Indian professionals.
picks.hook: Gemini ab aapka Mac khud control karega!

picks.title: AutoClip: Open-source AI video clipping tool
picks.angle: Indian creators can now automatically turn long podcasts or interviews into viral Shorts and Reels.
picks.hook: Long videos se viral Shorts banao ek click mein.

picks.title: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
picks.angle: Real-time transcription makes note-taking and content creation effortless for students and creators.
picks.hook: ChatGPT ab aapke bolte hi live typing karega.

picks.title: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
picks.angle: The iconic Google homepage is changing to prioritize AI interaction, affecting every Indian internet user.
picks.hook: Google Search ka homepage hamesha ke liye badal gaya.

picks.title: Pancreatic cancer halted by virus injection in three patients
picks.angle: A major medical breakthrough using viral tech to fight one of the deadliest cancers.
picks.hook: Scientists ne virus se cancer ko rok diya!

picks.title: Meta’s new Muse Charm device may cost $300
picks.angle: Meta's new AI wearable is entering the market at a competitive price point for tech enthusiasts.
picks.hook: Meta ka naya AI wearable sirf 300 dollars mein?

picks.title: Anthropic hits Nasdaq exchanges at $111
picks.angle: The creator of Claude AI is now a public company, marking a massive milestone in the AI industry.
picks.hook: Claude banane wali company Anthropic ab stock market par!

picks.title: Ghost-Downloader-3: The only downloader you need
picks.angle: A powerful all-in-one tool for Indian users to download media from across the web.
picks.hook: Har cheez download karne ke liye bas ek tool.

picks.title: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
picks.angle: Apple is finally moving toward autonomous AI agents, promising a smarter iPhone experience soon.
picks.hook: Apple bhi apna khud ka AI agent la raha hai.

picks.title: 180B Parameters, 32GB of RAM: Pushing MoE Inference to the Limit
picks.angle: Massive AI models can now run on standard consumer PCs, democratizing high-end AI for Indian students.
picks.hook: Bhari AI models ab saste PC par chalenge.

picks.title: Claude solves two open problems in the physics of black holes
picks.angle: AI is now solving complex scientific mysteries that humans couldn't crack for years.
picks.hook: Claude AI ne solve ki black hole ki mystery.

picks.title: Everything you need to survive and rebuild society
picks.angle: A fascinating open-source project documenting essential human knowledge for survival.
picks.hook: Duniya khatam hui toh yeh website kaam aayegi.
